meaning:
ὀρχέομαι, -οῦμαι
[in LXX for רָקַד, etc. ;]
to dance; Mat.11:17 14:6, Mrk.6:22, Luk.7:32.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: and say, ‘We played the flute for you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned for you, and you didn’t lament.’
When the daughter of Herodias herself came in and danced, she pleased Herod and those sitting with him. The king said to the young lady, “Ask me whatever you…
They are like children who sit in the marketplace, and call to one another, saying, ‘We piped to you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned, and you didn’t weep.’
